summary: STEP 3 (Prices, Customers, B2B Quotas + Admin Pricing UI) tested end-to-end. All 21 pytest backend tests passed. Frontend Admin Pengaturan Harga loads from live API, save+persist+refresh-revert flows confirmed, no console errors on / /dashboard /production /courier /absen.

issues: Recharts emits a benign 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warning on initial mount before container measures. Cosmetic only — chart renders fine after layout. Consider giving ResponsiveContainer an explicit minWidth/minHeight to silence.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx is 988 lines — getting close to the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting PricingView, B2BView, OverviewView into separate component files in a future refactor.

POST /api/prices/bulk is destructive (delete_many + insert_many). It is NOT wrapped in a transaction; a crash mid-call would leave the prices collection empty. Acceptable for a small write-rarely table, but worth a comment for future-proofing (e.g. switch to bulk_write upserts keyed on service_id).

Customer search uses unescaped regex from user input (`q` is interpolated into $regex). A query like `q=.*` works fine but a malformed regex (e.g. `q=(`) will surface as a 500 from MongoDB. Recommend re.escape() before passing to $regex.
Customer phone uniqueness is enforced application-side only — no Mongo unique index on `customers.phone`. A race between two simultaneous POSTs could insert duplicates. Add an index in db init.
test_credentials: Not required — admin pages are open in this preview build.
seed_data_creation: Used POST /api/seed/all to reset DB before tests. Restored prices via /api/seed/prices after destructive bulk-replace and frontend save tests, and /api/seed/b2b after delta tests. DB left in clean seeded state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: STEP 3 scope (Prices CRUD bulk-replace, Customers CRUD + quota deduct, B2B usage delta, Admin Pengaturan Harga UI) verified green. /api/seed/all returns the documented counts. Admin pricing input formats numbers with Indonesian locale dots ('6.000'); when fetching back via input_value() Playwright also sees the formatted string. POS/Courier/Production/Attendance remain mocked. Next steps will likely add Order creation from POS or wire the Customers UI — backend endpoints for those resources are ready.
rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA in this iteration.
